about: Cases for PhoneNumbers.spokenForm, the number as a screen reader should read it in the Call action: each digit on its own so it can be checked against what was said, groups apart by a comma, a + kept on the first digit. Read by OzenKitTests (PhoneNumbersSpokenTests, Swift) and core PhoneNumbersSpokenTest (Kotlin); each text holds one number, and spoken is the form for the first number found in it.
